protocol: PLAN.md dated note 2026-10-10 (timing protocol): three independent runs, separate processes started 60 s apart, nvidia-smi utilization, clocks and compute-process snapshots before and after each run; the statement is the range of the per-run medians-ratio across runs. Clocks unlocked; no driver setting touched. Dispatches under about 1 ms are flagged clock-sensitive.
window: RTX 4090, driver 610.88, one lock window 2026-10-12T19:27:04Z to 19:34:19Z (token engine-hw-1012-5025-1791833224), binaries gpu/bin-1012 at fbda078. Snapshots: no other compute process on the GPU in any snapshot (desktop graphics processes only). Raw files in hw-rtx4090-20261012/.
supersedes: the first window's timings (withdrawn 2026-10-10) and the two quiet reruns of 2026-10-10, which had two runs, not three

h1_2_wave_scan_vs_groupshared.statement: 1.007x to 1.011x: under 1.1% faster in every run; clock-sensitive (0.28 ms dispatch)

h1_2_fp16_vs_fp32_bilateral.statement: 0.976x in every run: fp16 is 2.4% slower on this kernel; clock-sensitive (0.22 ms dispatch). The 7.17x of the first window is withdrawn.

h1_3_mesh_vs_vertex_pulling.statement: faster in every run only on the close views (terrain 1.23x to 1.99x, hall 1.25x to 1.47x); slower in every run on terrain wide (0.63x to 0.88x) and hall grazing (0.85x to 0.88x); unstable in sign on terrain grazing and hall wide. Identity (triangle id and depth) holds in every run; the hall close flipped-cone control is the recorded miss (0 pixels change).

h1_4_async_overlap.statement: 0.987x to 0.991x: about 1% slower, no overlap gain

h1_7_cooperative_matrix_vs_shared_memory.statement: 6.35x to 7.12x the fallback across sizes and runs; 45.0 to 47.8 TFLOPS fp16 in, fp32 accumulate. The n1024 dispatch (0.045 ms) is clock-sensitive.

does_not_prove: Speed on other GPUs, drivers or clocks; speed in a full frame; that the fallbacks are the best possible non-hardware forms (they are ours and simple).
